job.title: [Post] We're Hiring: DevOps SFCC Architect We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Commerce…

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Enterprise Architecture & Integrations
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: DevOps SFCC Architect
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in leading enterprise commerce architecture at your organisation. With over five years of specialized experience building, extending, and supporting large-scale enterprise e-commerce platforms for global clients like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in platform engineering and backend integrations.

bullets.label: Enterprise Commerce Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, following platform best practices, design patterns, and enterprise standards.

bullets.label: Cloud & Deployment Workflows
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows, managing containerized environments and deployment pipelines.

bullets.label: API & System Integration
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, while building robust data pipelines connecting PIM, ERP, and MDM systems for synchronized multi-channel commerce.

bullets.label: Performance & Production Support
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring and system optimization to reduce response latency, troubleshoot production bottlenecks, and maintain high availability across global deployments.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, and I am available to start from 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my enterprise e-commerce background aligns with your architectural goals.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to bring my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and backend integration expertise to Samruddhi Rajguru's team. Building scalable platforms, optimizing cloud deployment cycles, and aligning complex system architectures for global enterprises like Rockwell Automation and Shell has prepared me to drive robust architectural solutions and high-performing commerce ecosystems here.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce platform engineering, cloud deployments, and backend integrations to lead scalable architecture.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello Samruddhi, I bring 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce architecture, cloud deployments, and backend integration experience from Rockwell Automation and Shell. I'd love to connect and discuss how my platform engineering background fits your team. Best, Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_subject: Application: DevOps SFCC Architect – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Samruddhi Rajguru,

I am writing to apply for the DevOps SFCC Architect position. With over five years of enterprise e-commerce platform engineering experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in cloud deployments, backend integrations, and scalable architecture.

Please find my CV and cover letter attached. I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, and my earliest available start date is 16 December 2026 following my notice period.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
